title: Apocalypse dream
content: So last night I had a short but strange dream. I was in a place that I felt was a school gym or auditorium, something like that, it had light wood floors and a stage. There were lots of tables with banquet buffet style food and it was super packed. I felt like it was familiar for some reason, the place the people the event. A whole crowd of people walked in and I ran to them like I was expecting and waiting for them. I dont remember who any of them were, probably just people I met throughout my life. And then the sky outside turned black and there was a huge blast that tore everything apart. Few people were conscious and then I woke up.
